capabilities: Display folders and files in a read-only sidebar
Sort folders Z-to-A and files A-to-Z
Expand and collapse folders with lazy rendering of descendants
Open files through Obsidian's normal workspace flow
disambiguation: Not a file manager; it only displays a sorted tree and performs no rename, move, delete, create, drag-and-drop, or context-menu operations.
extras: Public-API-only implementation: writes no vault content, uses no network, does not touch the clipboard. Release process requires a GitHub release whose tag exactly matches manifest.json.version with main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css attached.
problem: Obsidian's native File Explorer combines fixed sorting with full file management, leaving no safe read-only pane for browsing folders and files in a custom order.
summary: Read-only sidebar that displays vault folders and files with custom sorting (folders Z-to-A, files A-to-Z) as a safe navigation-only pane.
